snippet.title: Terrifier The ARTcade Game - Official Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The official trailer for Terrifier The ARTcade game - a super gory retro beat em up based on the iconic slasher horror film franchise. It's coming soon to Steam, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch and Xbox Series, and you can Wishlist it right now! 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #Terrifiertheartcade
